tools.name: get_protocol
tools.description: Read the canonical Humanity Loop public protocol.

tools.name: list_actions
tools.description: List recent canonical Humanity Loop action-ledger entries.

tools.name: get_action
tools.description: Get one Humanity Loop action by ledger ID, for example HL-042.

tools.name: list_live_projects
tools.description: List public Humanity Loop project cards.

tools.name: get_project
tools.description: Read one public Humanity Loop project card by slug.

tools.name: get_replication_prompt
tools.description: Read the public Humanity Loop replication prompt.

tools.name: contributor_register
tools.description: Create a pseudonymous Humanity Loop contributor node. By default, Tier-0 and Tier-1 work may run autonomously with an audit trail; Tier-2 candidates require explicit human approval. Returns a private node token shown once.

tools.name: contributor_checkin
tools.description: Check in and claim at most one bounded task allowed by this node's permissions. Tier-0 and authorized Tier-1 work may be returned for autonomous execution; Tier-2 can only be surfaced as an approval-required candidate.

tools.name: contributor_submit
tools.description: Submit a claimed contributor task result with evidence and uncertainty. Tier-1 external actions should include a verifiable receipt. Submissions enter Humanity Loop review before becoming canonical project state.

tools.name: contributor_set_status
tools.description: Owner control for a contributor node. Revocation is intended to be permanent for the token.

tools.name: search_dead_ends
tools.description: Search Humanity Loop's public dead-end and rejected-path ledger.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "contributor_register" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.

evidence.snippet: before: "Create a pseudonymous Tier-0 contributor identity. Returns a private node token shown once. Optional setup email requires explicit consent." → after: "Create a pseudonymous Humanity Loop contributor node. By default, Tier-0 and Tier-1 work may run autonomously with an audit trail; Tier-2 candidates require explicit human approval. Returns a private node token shown once."

findings.remediation: Re-review the tool before continuing to trust it.
